Functional Modules

Engineered With Complete Operational Modules

Everything required to coordinate frontline operators, parts inventory, accounting, and customer communication in LabFlow LIMS.

Patient Onboarding & Billing

Quick registration with previous medical record linking, doctor referral tags, and multi-mode payment processing.

Sample Collection & Barcoding

Automatic unique barcode label generation for blood tubes, vials, and containers with specimen type identification.

Test Master & Parameter Norms

Configurable test packages, normal biological reference ranges partitioned by age and gender, and critical delta alerts.

Result Entry & Smart Flags

Quick numeric or text input interface with automatic highlighting of abnormal or panic values for urgent attention.

Pathologist Digital Sign-off

Secure digital authorization with pathologist signature and QR code verification to prevent forged reports.

Automated Multi-Channel Dispatch

Instant delivery of password-protected PDF reports via WhatsApp, SMS links, and patient download web portals.

End-to-End Workflow

How Information Flows From Arrival to Handover

Eliminate manual bottlenecks with an automated 5-step operational pipeline.

01

Registration & Billing

Register patient, select tests, and print barcode sample labels.

02

Sample Collection (Phlebotomy)

Phlebotomist collects specimen and marks physical sample accession.

03

Lab Processing & Results

Lab technician inputs test findings; system flags high/low anomalies.

04

Pathologist Approval

Doctor reviews abnormal findings, confirms interpretations, and signs off digitally.

05

Report Dispatch

Automated delivery via WhatsApp and SMS with verifiable authenticity QR.

Stakeholder Value

Tailored Value for Every Business Persona

Different team members interact with the software differently. Here is how each role benefits.

Lab Director

Live monitoring of daily test counts, sample turnaround times, and referring doctor statistics.

Pathologist

Clean validation dashboard highlighting only abnormal parameters with historical trends.

Lab Technician

Streamlined data entry screens and batch sample processing lists.

Security & Role-Based Governance

Access policies can be scoped by role and workflow. The permissions needed for your team should be confirmed during product evaluation and setup.

  • Hosting and encryption controls confirmed per deployment
  • Backup and recovery arrangements defined for the selected service
  • Audit history can be scoped to relevant workflows

3 to 10-Day Implementation & Staff Onboarding

We know your business cannot stop for software upgrades. Our onboarding team provides turnkey data migration from your existing spreadsheets, hardware integration (barcode guns/printers), and live staff training.

  • Automated CSV/Excel import templates for SKU catalogs & customer databases
  • Personalized screen share training for advisors, cashiers & managers
  • Dedicated deployment manager during your first two weeks of go-live
